name: @joe-broadhead/opencode-elevenlabs
description: Unofficial OpenCode plugin for ElevenLabs: manage voice and chat agents, review their calls, and generate speech, images and video through ElevenLabs' official MCP server, with a spending guard and files saved to disk

jelly.title: ElevenLabs
jelly.summary: Your ElevenLabs agents, their calls, and generated speech, images and video.

settings.label: Access
settings.description: How much the plugin's tools may do. Generates default rules for agents with a base allow rule.

choices.label: Allowed
choices.description: Every tool runs without asking, reads and changes alike.

choices.label: Ask before changes
choices.description: Reads run without asking. Each change asks you first.

settings.label: Region
settings.description: Which ElevenLabs environment's MCP server the plugin registers and signs in to. An isolated environment is a separate workspace with a separate account. Changing it needs a new sign-in.

settings.label: Call transcripts
settings.description: How much of a call's history the conversation tools may return. A transcript holds another person's words and no redaction is applied.

choices.label: Full
choices.description: The conversation tools return calls, their summaries and their transcripts.

choices.label: Metadata only
choices.description: Calls can be listed and counted. Their transcripts, summaries, messages and recordings are denied.

choices.label: Off
choices.description: Every conversation tool is denied, listing and counting included.

settings.label: Credit cap per session
settings.description: The most credits one session may spend, as a whole number. Leave it unset for no cap, the default.

settings.label: Daily credit cap
settings.description: The most credits the plugin may spend in a rolling 24 hours in this data directory, across sessions, scripts and restarts, as a whole number. Leave it unset for no cap, the default.

settings.label: Largest saved file (bytes)
settings.description: The largest file the save tool writes, in bytes: at least 1024. The default is 200 MB.
